en: {body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] I have-- I have to take a piss, I think.

Speak. Why did you run at the bar?
C'mon. Why'd you run?
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] I didn't *do* anything.
Why were your friends hiding you?
Woody. Talk. Why'd your friends give you cover?
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] She was just a girl. There's… there's nothin' going on.
Why did you beat up Faith? What's the reason?
What did she do? What were you two involved in?
Where'd you go? Huh? After we fought.
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] Nowhere. I went nowhere.
Woody. Where'd you go? Got an alibi?

[very tired; sad] This… just leave it alone, alright?
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] This… just leave it alone, alright?

Who was supposed to be where, Woody? Tell me.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; peeved] Nobody you give a fuck about.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; peeved] This is none of your goddamned concern, wolf.
Faith wasn't supposed to be there. Who'd you expect, and why?
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] [muttering] I don't know, I don't know!
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] Nobody got killed cause of me, nobody…
Faith shouldn't have been there. Who should've?
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; peeved] It's not important!
What should've happened, Woody?
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; peeved] I'm not a fucking murderer!
Woodsman…[sighs] you've gotta talk to me. Because Crane and Bluebeard? They think you're shit.

{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] [big sigh] Yeah… I know you do, wolf.
I know you know.
[punch drunk; pissed] Go to Hell.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; pissed] I know what you think of me, dog. You've been showing it ever since you walked in the room.
Help me help you, Woody. Let me get you out of here.
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] I'm getting pretty sleepy, Sheriff.

You're better than this, Woody. Just help us.
C'mon, just give us something to go on here.
You say you had nothing to do with it. Then prove it.
This would go a lot quicker if you stopped blaming me for the situation you're in.
This ain't my fault. I can get you home, just work with me here.
[punch drunk; pissed] Sing it to the fuckin' clouds, Sheriff, cause I don't give a shit.
[punch drunk; pissed] Tell you what. You let me bite your goddamn nose off, we'll call this whole thing even.
[very tired; sad] I'd tell you somethin' if there was something to tell.
[very tired; sad] I don't know what you think I know, but there's just…there's just nothin' there, Sheriff.
[very cold] No.
I'm not a patient man, Woodsman.
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; sad] No?
You're in deep shit.
Got it?
[calm] I am going to start having fun with you.
[calm] If you don't start talking… and I mean fast…
[calm] You'll pray to any God who'll listen that your mother never shit you into this fucking world.
[calm] I'm going to cut off your fingers, one by one, till the kids down the block call you, "Oven Mitts."

{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] You won't do shit with the Deputy there.
[very tired; sad] [big sigh] I'm done with this whole fucking thing, Bigby.
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired; perturbed] It's not worth all that, fuck.
[calm] Woody, I'm gonna start breaking bones. And I'm gonna start with the ones you *need*, understand?
{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] Go for it. I ain't talkin' no more.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; pissed] That shit won't work anymore, Wolf.
[calm] I swear to God, Woody, you're gonna be my own personal chew toy in about five seconds if you don't open your mouth and talk.
[calm] Look, you better start talking, right fucking now.
[calm] Do not fuck with me, Woodsman.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; pissed] You're a big stupid fucking mutt, and I'm not in the talking mood.
{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; pissed] Blow me.

{body-SitCuffed}[very tired] Is this how you get your rocks off, wolf?

[after being punched; punch drunk] My tooth, you fucking asshole!

[punch drunk; pissed] Get me out of this goddamned chair!
[being punched] {body-SitCuffed}Arhg!
[being punched in the face] {body-SitCuffed}Aaghgh!

{body-SitCuffed}[punch drunk; pissed; muttering to himself] Bitch. Fuckin' bitch.
[punch drunk; sad] Yeah, it's like the old days.
[cold] Who were you expecting?
[cold] No, it doesn't.
[punch drunk; pissed] Lily is [in pain]errmph-- Holly's sister.
[cold] [cut]You can worry about Holly later.

Holly, the bartender?
[very tired; sad] Don't tell Holly. Please, Bigby.[beat] They're not right, the two of them. She'd be pissed.
[very tired; sad] I couldn't… I didn't want to say anything. Having been seen with that woman, Faith, and now… having ties to Lily, a girl who's missing… it doesn't look good.
[cold] Who was it?[beat] Tell me.
[punch drunk; pissed] Lily.
Lily? Who's Lily?
Bigby, really, this has gone far enough.
Sheriff, that is it. Okay? I just-- I have to put a stop to this.
You said you would find another way, and you haven't. So that's it. The man has rights.
I warned you earlier, and you haven't listened. And now, it's just truly gone too far. The man has rights.
[groaning in pain; very tired; sighing]
Bluebeard, that's enough now!
[amused, to himself] His rights are on temporary leave.
You don't give a shit about the Woodsman's rights, you just don't want any heat on you.
It only so happens that my, uh, more beaurocratic concerns also happen to line up with what's ethically right!
[cut]Yes, fine, you got me, I care what Fabletown will think about this!
[cut]But I have to care what Fabletown will think because no one else in this room does!
[cut]If the town finds out about this, Bigby, it won't matter what we drained out of the Woodsman because nobody is going to care!
You're not thinking of the bigger picture here!
[cut]You're acting like I set the guy on fire.
[Trimmed]Snow deserves justice, Crane… and the little arm-twisting I did to get us closer shouldn't keep any of us up at night.
We're getting what I came here for, Crane. Information.
And then we'll never catch who did this. The whole thing will have been for naught.
I dare say this is the exact kind of infantile rashness that got Miss White killed.
You never think out the ramifications for things! Beating information out of someone will simply never get the people aligned with us.
I think they're in here…?
[through gritted teeth] You have absolutely no fucking idea what this has been like for--
[furious; through his teeth] Fuck. You.
[getting angry himself] I have some idea, yes, I think I do.
[furious] Don't you blame me for Snow's death!
[sputtering, scared] I only meant…you know…
[amused; chuckles] [cut] Well now there's a thought.
[very tired; sad] Yeah, her sister's a prostitute.
[very tired] Lily.
[very tired; sad] Lily is Holly's sister.
[calm] Who were you expecting?
[very tired; sad] I couldn't… I didn't want to say anything.
[very tired; sad] Just please, don't tell anyone, Bigby.[beat] Gren and her, that whole bar, they just-- they wouldn't understand.
[punch drunk; pissed] I think Grendel stopped by the office this week to report her missing. Not that you fuckers would notice.
[punch drunk; pissed] So la-dee-fucking-da, congrats. You cracked the case wide open, shithead.
[punch drunk; pissed] And now I'm sure you think I'm the killer. I was seen last with that bitch, Faith, and I was also fucking the missing girl.
[punch drunk; pissed; sadder now] [cut]Bet you can't wait to run off and tell Holly and ruin my goddamned life.
This barbarian knows more than he's letting on. You can't continue to treat him like some stupid American waif!
Well, congratulations, Sheriff, we've been here for God knows how long and what do we have to show for it?
You had the right idea earlier, but then softened up. We're never going to get anywhere just "chatting" with him!
He's talking, alright? My "methods" work fine.
No, they don't. They're not working at all.
I am here to find Snow White's killer. And seeing how much you've embarrassed yourself, I'm glad for her sake that I am.
[annoyed] I was under the impression you were just here to watch…
Or what? Because if today's events have been any indication, I have nothing to fear from your pitiful threats.
[intimidating] Find the door or shut the hell up.
Oh, now you turn on the charm.
Then you have no imagination, I'm sorry to say.
Because my best is a whole lot better than this!
[weakly] I really think it's going the best that it can…
[frustrated] Bigby, look, you had your turn. Now it's time to try things my way.
[CUT!!!] Now, Bluebeard, let's let Bigby handle this, please…[CUT!!!]
[calming down a little] And interrogations are supposed to be fun, you know.
[CUT!!!] Now… move aside so I can expedite things. [CUT!!!]
[CUT!!!] Snow White is dead! She was one of us! Not one of them! [CUT!!!]

How worse can they get?!
[fearful] Don't make things worse!
[highly dismissive] You're pathetic, Bluebeard.
[quietly cold] You are no friend to justice, Bigby.
[cold] Don't take another step.

Mmph.

[very tired; big sigh]
You'll have to explain this.

What took you so long?

[quietly relieved] Snow… I've been thinking you were dead for hours.
[relaxed] Hi, Snow. What took you so long?
[very matter of fact] Yeah.[beat] Not dead.
[plainly] We found the body.
[stunned] How is this possible?
We don't know who it is yet.
[tired sarcasm] Surprise.
[plainly] She was "made" to look like me, and… [small sigh]we don't know who it is yet.
[knowingly] What's going on here?
[plainly disappointed] What have you been doing, Bigby?
I tried to stop them.
Just questioning a suspect.

Interrogating the Woodsman.

At Toad's, most of the night…

[stern] Trying to find out who killed you.

[tired; annoyed] I've been up all night.

Let him go.
Keep him for now.
At Toad's for most of the night.

We-- [stops herself]
